description: Implementation of AES encryption algorithm supporting ECB and CBC modes, including key expansion, encryption, decryption, and mode-specific buffer processing.

methods.name: KeyExpansion
methods.description: Generates round keys from the initial key based on AES key schedule.

methods.name: AddRoundKey
methods.description: XORs the state with the round key for a given round.

methods.name: SubBytes
methods.description: Substitutes bytes in the state using the S-box.

methods.name: ShiftRows
methods.description: Performs row shifting in the state for encryption.

methods.name: MixColumns
methods.description: Mixes columns in the state for diffusion during encryption.

methods.name: InvSubBytes
methods.description: Inverse substitution of bytes in the state.

methods.name: InvShiftRows
methods.description: Performs row shifting in the state for decryption.

methods.name: InvMixColumns
methods.description: Inverse mixing of columns in the state for decryption.

methods.name: Cipher
methods.description: Encrypts the current state using AES rounds.

methods.name: InvCipher
methods.description: Decrypts the current state using AES rounds.

methods.name: AES_ECB_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data in ECB mode.

methods.name: AES_ECB_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data in ECB mode.

methods.name: AES_CBC_encrypt_buffer
methods.description: Encrypts data in CBC mode with IV.

methods.name: AES_CBC_decrypt_buffer
methods.description: Decrypts data in CBC mode with IV.
